title: "Keep launchers separate" should work with sorting modes other than manual
line: "Keep launchers separate" can now be turned off in every sort mode except "Do not sort", so pinned apps sort together with open windows.
explanation: In the Icons-and-Text Task Manager's Behavior page the "Keep launchers separate" checkbox was only enabled with "Manually" sorting, and main.qml forced the tasks model's separateLaunchers to true for every other sort mode, so an unchecked value set earlier was silently ignored and launchers always stayed at the start of the panel. libtaskmanager already sorts launchers together with tasks by the chosen sort key when separateLaunchers is false. The change enables the checkbox for every sort mode except "Do not sort" (where the order is just the model order, so the option has no effect) and passes the setting to the model in those modes.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: allow mixing launchers with tasks in any sort mode

"Keep launchers separate" could only be changed with manual sorting and
was ignored otherwise, so launchers always sat at the start. Enable it
in every sort mode except "Do not sort" and pass it to the tasks model.

BUG: 484169

patches.diff:
From 7653f41f547efa94943c53d60a8ef09ff987944d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 20:39:42 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: allow mixing launchers with tasks in any
 sort mode

"Keep launchers separate" could only be changed with manual sorting and
was ignored otherwise, so launchers always sat at the start. Enable it
in every sort mode except "Do not sort" and pass it to the tasks model.

BUG: 484169
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml | 2 +-
 applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml           | 2 +-
 2 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
index bd4b7cf008..ff04215663 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigBehavior.qml
@@ -163,7 +163,7 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
             id: separateLaunchers
             visible: (Plasmoid.pluginName !== "org.kde.plasma.icontasks")
             text: i18nc("@option:check configure task sorting", "Keep launchers separate")
-            enabled: sortingStrategy.currentValue === TaskManager.TasksModel.SortManual
+            enabled: sortingStrategy.currentValue !== TaskManager.TasksModel.SortDisabled
         }
 
         QQC2.CheckBox {
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
index d0a62d21bc..951fc2bf35 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/main.qml
@@ -174,7 +174,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         launchInPlace: tasks.iconsOnly && Plasmoid.configuration.sortingStrategy === 1
         separateLaunchers: {
             if (!tasks.iconsOnly && !Plasmoid.configuration.separateLaunchers
-                && Plasmoid.configuration.sortingStrategy === 1) {
+                && Plasmoid.configuration.sortingStrategy !== 0) {
                 return false;
             }
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Sort: Alphabetically, "Keep launchers separate" is greyed out
Same settings: the checkbox can be changed
Alphabetical sort with the option unchecked in the config: pinned System Settings and Info Center still sit at the start
Same config: pinned apps sort alphabetically among the windows (Dolphin, Info Center, Konsole, System Settings)

review.text: Enables "Keep launchers separate" in `ConfigBehavior.qml` and honors it in `main.qml` for all active sorting modes while keeping it disabled only for "Do not sort" (where `TasksModel` does not sort) and leaving Icons-only unchanged. This cleanly leverages `libtaskmanager`'s existing mixed-sorting support without unnecessary config changes or regressions. Screenshots confirm both the enabled UI control and alphabetical interleaving of pinned launchers with open windows.

reviews.text: Enables "Keep launchers separate" in `ConfigBehavior.qml` and honors it in `main.qml` for all active sorting modes while keeping it disabled only for "Do not sort" (where `TasksModel` does not sort) and leaving Icons-only unchanged. This cleanly leverages `libtaskmanager`'s existing mixed-sorting support without unnecessary config changes or regressions. Screenshots confirm both the enabled UI control and alphabetical interleaving of pinned launchers with open windows.

Right layer and a tiny diff, and for Alphabetical it works as the screenshots show: launchers sort in among the windows. But the checkbox is now also enabled for By desktop, By activity and By horizontal window position, where libtaskmanager's lessThan still puts launchers first (they count as on all desktops, and lessThanByVirtualDesktop runs before the geometry/activity keys). The verify notes confirm this for By desktop: launchers still come first, and the only effect of unchecking is that they lose their pinned order and fall back to alphabetical. That leaves an enabled option that doesn't do what its label says in three of the four newly enabled modes, including the reporter's own By desktop mode, and it silently reorders pins.
changes: Either enable the checkbox (and pass separateLaunchers=false) only in the sort modes where libtaskmanager actually mixes launchers with tasks (Manual and Alphabetically), or extend TasksModel::Private::lessThan so non-separate launchers really interleave in By desktop / By activity / By horizontal position instead of only losing their pin order.

Re-verify each enabled sort mode with the option unchecked, showing the launchers mixed in (not just first in alphabetical order), and update the commit message and explanation to name the modes covered.
